headline: District of Columbia yet to concede
dek: The capital side have not been scored on, across a goalless draw at Goldey-Beacom and a home win over Seton Hill. Lorenzo Herrera has made thirteen saves and has not yet been beaten.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Staten Island have scored as often as St. Thomas Aquinas, yet have conceded seven and are the only side still without a point: this chart ranks attacks, and attack has not been their problem.

wire.line: The conference has drawn as often as it has won against outside opposition, and lost more often than either.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches are past their date with no result published: District of Columbia's opening-day trip to Shepherd and Molloy's at Caldwell. There are no score gaps.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Matthew Solorio has kept two clean sheets for D'Youville, and both were goalless draws: the side has still not won.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Queens have scored four times through four different players.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Daemen have conceded six goals and are still without a win, a total only Staten Island have exceeded.

last_match.line: Roberts Wesleyan's first defeat, after their win at Assumption; Saint Anselm have now beaten Staten Island and Roberts Wesleyan and lost at home to Molloy.

next_match.line: Dominican have already lost at home to Queens and to St. Thomas Aquinas without scoring a goal; Staten Island have been beaten in both of their matches.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
